text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...So, to liven up the Appreciation Festival, King went and proposed
something that extravagant, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! King has her gaze fixed on a grand dream. A dream where,
no matter the contest, her cheers bestow boundless power upon everyone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And beyond that——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san! I managed to extend my stride by three centimeters!
A brand-new personal best! With this, the actual event is guaranteed
to be a resounding triumph!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...For the sake of her cherished junior,
she is prepared to go to any length.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yet that pride of hers is precisely why King will never allow herself
to lean on others, even in the most critical moments.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ah~~... so that's the story.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu. After all, one never wishes to display their unrefined moments
before someone who idolizes them, correct?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That is why, should King ever begin to lose her footing,
I would like you to support her. I'm counting on you♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah~~~ give me a break~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Today marks our "Cheer Practice Session"! On the day of the
Appreciation Festival, it cannot merely be our school's Cheer Squad.
We must rally all the spectators into one voice!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To that end, our Cheerleading Squad was granted a special opportunity:
permission to invite fans to take part in our rehearsals——

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me. I'm trying to head over to the course,
would you happen to know the way?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, fret not! You are here for the practice session,
are you not!? Allow me to guide you there!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(We are permitted only two practice sessions before the main event.
I shall utilize both to achieve absolute perfection, so that when the day arrives——)

text_block_list.name: Festival Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! Hooray! Tra-ce-n!
Fight! Fight! Umamusume! Go!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As expected of our first-class Cheer Captain...! Thanks to
King-san's cheering, I shattered the Tracen Academy
record and claimed 1st place!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohoho, without fail, King shall see this through to victory!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... so this is where we'll be practicing~. We have to be super loud
so we don't get drowned out by the Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ufufuu, I made sure to bring the megaphone I used last year!
It'll be wonderful if we can make this year's cheering just as amazing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It appears everyone has assembled! Then without further ado, let us
commence! To deliver the finest cheers imaginable—— Gather round!

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, what an impressive tone...! Wait!? That trumpeter,
I swear I've seen them on TV before!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! I enlisted a first-class brass band specifically for
today! A King utilizes every connection at her disposal!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone! Ensure you raise your spirits as grandly and
resoundingly as possible! To all of you gathered here, I grant the
sublime privilege of basking in this King's radiance!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...And there goes King again...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
With preparations of this caliber, failure is entirely out of the question.
Beginning with this very first rehearsal, it shall undeniably be a soaring triumph!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, let us match the trumpet's cadence
and try once more! One, two!!
(A chaotic cacophony of whistles, clicks, drums, and disjointed shouting)

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan A
text_block_list.text: J-just now... did our voices actually sound synchronized...?

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah... maybe...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-of course they were! That was an absolutely rousing cheer! Ohohoho, we shall keep this momentum going!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...And now, with this!!
(Whoooosh... Flutter flutter...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Look at all those pretty balloons, up, up and away into the sky...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: According to the internet, this is the ultimate way to cheer! Now then, doesn't this make you want to let your voices ring out loud and proud!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Come now, shout to your heart's content! Fight, ooooh--!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan C
text_block_list.text: F-fight, ooooh...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, just like that! Fiii--

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *Cough*, *cough*! *Hack*!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...King!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's take a break for now. I get that you're eager to give it your all, but you've been screaming at full throttle since the very start...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We cannot stop yet! We haven't even brought the energy up to proper standards...! As the leader, it is my duty to pull everyone forward and fire up the crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where are you going!? W-wait! King!?
(TA-DAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Participating Fans
text_block_list.text: W-what's going on...!? Spotlights...!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Everyone, feel the rhythm and ride the groove!! Put your hands in the air!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeh!? You went and prepped something totally bizarre without telling anyone again...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haaaaalt right there!! Making such an unruliness and using blinding strobe lights is a blatant breach of academy regulations!!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Members & Fans
text_block_list.text: Good work today... Thanks for the hard work, everyone... See you next time!

text_block_list.name: Fan Carrying a Fan B
text_block_list.text: ...Man, somehow today was just utterly exhausting, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Participating Fan A
text_block_list.text: Well, it was our very first rehearsal after all... I do wonder if we'll actually manage to pull it off for the real event, though~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...King, great job out there. What's the plan for tonight's practice? If you'd like to work out some of today's kinks, I'd be glad to pitch in!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, well, about that.

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member A
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... I totally stumbled on the choreography and call-outs...

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member C
text_block_list.text: ...You've got your regular training tomorrow too, right? Let's take it easy so we don't wear ourselves out.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's quite all right. Everyone must already be thoroughly exhausted from today's efforts.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Next time, we shall make it a resplendent success! Until then, everyone, have a good evening!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That is why, if King ever starts losing sight of her path, I'd like you to lend her a hand. I'm counting on you, alright?♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...If today were the real deal...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The cheers... why are they so dreadfully half-hearted~?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... In the end, not a single soul was rooting for me... For some reason... I feel so faint...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: --Keep your chin up, King! We will surely ignite their spirits with our cheering! What kind of first-class lady falters after a mere stumble or two?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I must guide everyone properly. I need to take point, shine brightly, and elevate everyone's passion...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I have it! I shall commission a gigantic electronic billboard! That will display the exact timing for each chant! And then, we'll blast the music--

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Out for a late-night stroll too, King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Nature-san...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, care to tag along for a bit? The evening breeze feels pretty nice, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, let's go, King.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Let's go broaden our horizons a little.
